title: E0091: Source code exposure via highlight_file
plain_english: Using `highlight_file()`, `show_source()`, or `highlight_string()` in production code can expose PHP source code, including credentials and application logic, to anyone who can access that page.
why_matters: Source code disclosure can expose: - Database credentials and API keys - Business logic and application flow - Other vulnerabilities in the codebase - Third-party library versions
good_example:
// Remove source-highlighting functions from production code.
// If debugging is needed, use a local development environment.
what_it_checks: Especially risky when gated by user input (`$_GET['debug']`)
